author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: प्रश्नस्योत्तरमाह सार्धैश्चतुर्भिः। हे पार्थ इह लोके अमुत्र परलोके च नाशस्तस्य नास्ति ।  इह नाशस्तिर्यगादिदुर्गतिप्राप्तिः। परत्र नाशो नरकप्राप्तिः।  तद्द्वयं तस्य योगभ्रष्टस्य नेत्यर्थः । नञ्द्वयमादरार्थः ।  कुतं इत्यत उक्तम् ॥  न हीति ।  कल्याणकृत् श्रद्ध्या किञ्चित्कालं ध्यानादिकृदित्यर्थः ॥ ६.४० ॥
translation:
The blessed Lord said: O Partha, neither here, nor there, does he come to destruction ; for no one that practises what is righteous, beloved, treads the path of woe. (40)

V. The destruction here is to be born as lower animals; and the destruction there is to be damned in hell. Neither of these evil results befalls him, who has fallen from Yoga. That .........righteous: who practises meditation and other pious duties with faith. (40)
A. Then what happens to him?
